control_flow: avoidWalls: if the right light is below 60 %, check the front and left obstacle sensors; otherwise call driveInTheDark.
In dim light: a front obstacle makes it turn left 15°, a left obstacle makes it turn right 15°, otherwise driveInTheDark.
driveInTheDark: if the left light is below 70 %, drive forward at 30 %; otherwise call stopAtWall.
stopAtWall: if a front obstacle is seen, stop; otherwise call followLine.
followLine: on black, curve left; otherwise curve right.

uncertainties: You said only that it shouldn't hit the tunnel walls; the line following and wall stop in bright light have no expected behaviour from your words.
The program reads only the front and left obstacle sensors, so it may hit a wall on its right in the dark without noticing it.
The light thresholds are 60 % and 70 %, so near a tunnel opening it may drive forward before it is fully in the dark.
